# lune-npm

A Node.js wrapper for Lune that allows you to install and use Lune through NPM.

## Installation

```bash
npm install -g lune
```

Or install locally in your project:

```bash
npm install lune
```

## Supported Platforms

- Windows (x64)
- macOS (x64, ARM64)
- Linux (x64)
